title: mesosphaerum hilarii
intro: Mesosphaerum hilarii, commonly known as Hilair's horn plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to relieve respiratory issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mesosphaerum hilarii include its use as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it effective in treating conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
